Public talks

I gave talks for general public, talks aimed at students age 11 – 18, and volunteered for science outreach events. As a student, I also helped organise and hosted several dozen Skeptics in the Pub events in Zagreb.

Recorded talks

  • “Promjenjive konstante” (eng. “Changing constants”) at the Skeptics in the Pub, Zagreb (HR), June 2024
  • “Do the laws of physics vary?”, virtually for Astronomy on tap Lonon (UK), May 2021
  • “Tamna strana svemira” (eng. “The dark side of the Universe”) at the Skeptics in the Pub, Zagreb (HR), June 2018

Other talks and projects

  • Gymnasium Petar Preradović, Virovitica, HR
  • Višnjan Summer School, Višnjan, HR
  • Ambassador of Astronomy to Croatia, IAU 100 funded project (proposer C. Harrison)
  • Volunteer at the Ask an Astronomer event, ESO Open Door day 2017, Garching, DE
  • Volunteer at the Open Door Day of the Ruđer Bošković Institute, Zagreb, HR
